_about: Clover Jig. Each tune is two four-bar parts, A and B, in 6/8 (jig) or 4/4 (reel), with the fiddle, tin whistle and bodhran; the four ceili tunes add harp, accordion and upright bass. The bpm of each part is in eighth notes, two dance beats a bar. The game plays A A B B twice, starting each part on its beat, and plays the caller's word one beat before each step. Written by a small seeded composer; render with python3 tools/render_sounds.py clover-jig.

sounds._about: Menu move: a light heel tap.
Menu select: a bodhran beat and a whistle note.
Menu back: a soft fiddle drop.
Pause music: a slow air on fiddle over harp, the dancers sitting out.
